title: Turning Settings OFF then ON keeps the sub-toggle choices
custom_preconds: 1. In the Page Access card: Settings ON, with App Settings ON, Service ON and View/Manage Wages ON, and Parts, Finance, Integrations, Data Import OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Turn Settings OFF.
  2. Notice the sub-toggles are hidden.
  3. Turn Settings back ON.
  4. Check the sub-toggle states.
custom_expected:
When Settings is off, the sub-toggles are hidden.

When Settings is turned back on, App Settings, Service and View/Manage Wages are still ON and the others are still OFF — the choices are kept, not cleared.
